name: Stepping Stone Ranch Summer Camp
description_short: A small week long day camp at a horse ranch in West Greenwich: campers hike in Arcadia Management Area, learn to handle and care for horses without riding, do arts and crafts and cool off with water play.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 'Camp Program for Children and Adults': hiking in Arcadia Management Area, horse time (no riding), arts and crafts, swim and splash; dates 'July 28 to August 1' and 'August 11 to 15' with no year, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Monday to Friday, limited to 15 campers per week, $399 per week. Those dates fall Monday to Friday only in 2025, so season_year is 2025 and no sessions are recorded. Lower on the page is an older 'Summer camps 2024' section ($395, 9:30 to 3).
Researched by Claude from this page. Home page footer: 201 Escoheag Hill Rd., West Greenwich RI 02817, 1-(401) 397-3725.
